caption: A dry sponge is dropped into a basin of water; it floats, darkens as it soaks up water, and settles lower.

sa.check: A dry sponge is dropped into a basin of water.
It darkens as it soaks up water.
The sponge is dry and light-coloured before the drop.
The drop comes first, then the float, then the darkening and settling.

pc.expect: The darkening spreads from the wet side and only spreads, and the sponge sinks gradually as it fills.
pc.fail: It sinks instantly like a stone; or it stays dry and high; or it lightens again.

pc.expect: The sponge is soft and porous: it soaks and sags.
pc.fail: Water beads off it like wax; or it dissolves; or it stays rigid.

pc.expect: It floats at the surface, part above water, and sits lower as it fills.
pc.fail: It floats above the surface; or hovers mid-water; or rises as it soaks.
There is no disturbance on entry; or ripples appear before it lands; or the water stays glassy.
The sponge vanishes or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or it passes through the basin.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The basin and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The basin changes colour; or the water changes colour; or the background rearranges.
